cards.title: Four dungeon styles
cards.text: Four whole looks for the dungeons, each in all three themes. Tick the one (or parts) you like.
cards.why: You asked for about 4 styles. All four are in the game: Settings, Dungeon look.
cards.details: Every style has walls sloping out on all sides, quieter floor decor and straight-down shadows. 12 floor patterns across them. Doors stay shut until the room is won, then open lit in the room's colour.
